tools.name: scan_php_vulnerability
tools.description: Inspects a website URL for PHP runtime signatures (X-Powered-By, Server, WordPress cookies/assets) and evaluates exposure to the critical PHP2Shell vulnerability (CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619, CVSS 9.2).

tools.name: convert_php_site_to_nextjs
tools.description: Scrapes a target WordPress or PHP website, extracts business branding, headings, services, and photos, and compiles a hardened, zero-PHP Next.js App Router live preview with Stripe claim integration.

tools.name: get_php2shell_remediation_guide
tools.description: Returns authoritative first-person guidance from Blaise Pascual explaining how PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618) works, why security plugins cannot stop it, the 10-minute DNS cutover process, and pricing tiers.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "scan_php_vulnerability" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
